scope: Twelve purposeful Waterwheel road-delivery targets and native delivery qualification, plus release of stale 3D HUD ownership on the supported 2D rendering path. Waterwheel remains an editable, non-awarding preview, not an eight-route campaign replacement.

acceptance.editor_viewport_note: Post-XR document restoration is asserted and the editor controls/minimap are captured. A blank main-canvas capture does not independently qualify the restored editor viewport paint; its cause was not established.

native_delivery.recipe: Real preview UI and 3D inspection; supported 2D complete CPU route; ordinary rightward riding; coast into a forward 35-145px throw window; sampled standard Xbox B; wait for real packet collision; resume riding. No player-position, velocity, delivery, score, win, record or document assignments.
native_delivery.coverage_limits: Not full-speed success at every eligible distance, not combined aerial-and-delivery qualification, not physical Xbox, and not an unfamiliar-player enjoyment/readability study.

retained_failures.details: South Quay delivered genuinely, then an outer-radius Parcel Market throw missed while full throttle was held. The rider remained alive and the later boxes remained targetable. The next recipe uses ordinary coasting, without changing physics or assigning deliveries.
Strict prototype equality differed across the isolated VM and Node despite identical serialized values. The oracle compares encoded values; codec and Workshop validation remain required.

The optional row was Controller guide rather than Portal atlas. The oracle now checks six rows against live Flight Deck DOM order and separately requires critical controls; stereo contrast, scenery isolation, tracking and persistence checks remain.
The correct Tideglass route 7 and three pools loaded, but the test required v0.23.0. It now checks both version and build against the exact checked-out manifest and retains the route assertion.

Visual review of the earlier passing delivery capture showed frozen 3D instruments. Final candidate 94dbd117 releases CloudHUD ownership on the existing shared 2D render path and adds native visibility/clock/pause assertions; no additional animation owner or physics change.

A local navigation attempt was blocked before gameplay by the container administrator policy. It supplies no browser acceptance. The retained GitHub-hosted browser reports supply the native evidence; local Node checks are a different evidence class.
